card.name: Capital K starting brand drug names
card.fires_on: The letter K when it begins a brand drug name (KISUNLA, KALBITOR, KORSUVA, KRAZATI, Kepivance, KABIVEN), usually right after a verb like withdraw, mix, administer or stop. Also fires on K in other names like Kussmaul.
